body:
Google Cloud Summit 2026 returned to Tobacco Dock in London for a third consecutive year under Kimber's production management, spreading across the venue's brick-vaulted rooms and dockside courtyards to bring Google Cloud's UK customer and partner community together across generative AI, infrastructure, security, and business transformation content, headlined by a Formula E AI Experience and a hands-on AI Playground activation zone.

As Senior Production Manager, Kimber combined heavyweight technical pre-production, including computational geometry for the bespoke AI Playground Drone Arena, bespoke crew sign in and check in software for over 1,000 contractors, and rebuilt kiosk signage animations, with on-the-ground delivery.

Xerocon London is Xero's flagship UK and Europe conference for the accounting and bookkeeping community, staged at Olympia London over two days in July 2026 for several thousand delegates across keynotes, breakout stages, and an exhibitor floor built around playful, branded activations.

As Technical Director, Kimber provided technical and production support across the show, keeping the main stage, partner stages, and exhibitor floor running to schedule alongside the wider production team.

Xerocon Denver is Xero's flagship US conference for accounting and bookkeeping professionals, held at the Colorado Convention Center over two days in August 2026. The show spans a broadcast-equipped main stage, Discovery and partner stages, an exhibitor hall, podcast recording space, and a dedicated small-business-community room.

As Technical Director, Kimber directly supported the team that kept every stage, broadcast feed, and exhibitor element aligned across the two-day show, coordinating a crew spanning content and AV through to the partner-stage teams.

Yoto PlayDate London 2026 was a brand experience event for the children's audio technology company Yoto, staged at the brand's London home to bring its product roadmap and community programmes to life for an invited audience.

As Executive Producer, working with Akcelo, Kimber led pre-production on the show, including cost planning and supplier procurement for a giant, fully-lit scale replica of the Yoto Player built as the event's centrepiece installation. With Kimber unavailable for the live dates, he built and contracted a trusted freelance delivery team to carry the project through fabrication, installation, and on-site delivery.

For Google Cloud Summit 2025 in London, Kimber led production management and technical delivery across nine live conference rooms running in parallel. The role sat at the intersection of content, technical infrastructure, and on-the-ground delivery, ensuring every room ran safely, smoothly, and on schedule.

As Production Manager, Kimber coordinated AV, staging, show flow, and crew across all nine spaces, managing keynotes, panels, breakouts, and workshops. Alongside owning his rooms, he provided floating production support across the wider event by resolving technical faults, supporting speakers and moderators, and adapting rooms to last-minute changes.

Held at Tobacco Dock in London, Google Cloud Summit 2024 brought together 4,000 attendees over two days to explore the latest advances in generative AI, security, cloud data, and collaboration technologies.

As the Technical credit on the experiential areas, Kimber delivered all audio-visual elements and ensured seamless execution across the AI technology activations and 60-plus exhibitor stands.

To launch Season 5 of Stranger Things, Netflix created an immersive fan experience at the historic Cirque d'Hiver in Paris, transporting guests into the world of Hawkins High School. The six-day event featured 12 interactive experience areas and a cast of 28 actors.

As Production Director, Kimber managed the full production team and supplier network, delivering the event in just seven weeks.

Canva Studio was a pop-up experiential activation in Holborn, Central London, designed to immerse guests in the Canva product through interactive experiences.

As Executive Producer, Kimber managed the client and supplier network from concept to delivery in six weeks, navigating tight deadlines, material availability challenges, and a complex set build. The activation was delivered on time and on budget.

Geely Auto's launch into the Australian market was delivered across three connected moments: a media drive day, internal staff training, and the official brand launch at Sydney's Luna Park for 400 guests. The headline moment featured an ambitious 360-degree projection blend powered by 37 projectors.

As Executive Producer, Kimber assembled and led the full freelance production team, managing client relationships, agency creatives, and finance teams throughout the project.

Xerocon is Xero's flagship B2B conference for accounting professionals, welcoming around 3,000 attendees from across the United States.

As Technical Director, Kimber oversaw the physical installation of the exhibition floor in Nashville and provided technical and production support to the Sydney-based production team.

The Visa Everywhere Initiative is a global innovation program that challenges startups to solve tomorrow's payment problems.

As Executive Producer, Kimber produced the European edition in Paris, managing venue, supplier, and client relationships across the event.

Google Pixel's Curiosity Rooms transformed 55 Regent Street in London into an immersive three-floor experience blending fashion, food, and technology over five weeks. The activation was developed in partnership with 72andSunny, OMD, Essence, and Halpern.

As Senior Producer, Kimber helped concept and deliver the experience in just eight weeks, coordinating creative, build, and operational teams across the partner network.

Aperol Spritz was the official aperitif sponsor of the Australian Open 2024.

As Executive Producer, Kimber oversaw the delivery of a standout concept store in Melbourne Airport's international departures terminal, including a bespoke tennis-themed interactive game and a large-format sunset installation.

Stella McCartney launched a sustainable innovation exhibit during the COP28 UN Climate Conference in Dubai.

As Executive Producer, Kimber led client handling, production management, and live event execution for a modular, sustainably built installation featuring 3D-printed stalls created using photocatalysis technology.

On site in Milan for the UEFA Champions League Final, Kimber delivered Mastercard's fan experience activation, including giveaways, priceless surprises, and branded fan-journey touchpoints across the city.

As Senior Producer, he managed supplier coordination, run-of-show, and live delivery to keep every brand moment consistent throughout the matchday weekend.

Mastercard's fan activation at The Open Championship at Royal Troon, Scotland, brought the brand's hospitality and fan-engagement programme on course.

As Senior Producer, Kimber delivered the activation on the ground, coordinating build, supplier teams, and live operations across the tournament.

MTV's exclusive EMA Awards after-party at the iconic Wembley Theatre welcomed VIP guests, talent, and A-list media to celebrate MTV's return to London after 12 years. The space featured London cityscape projections, a voile cube installation, and a real London Underground carriage integrated into the room.

As Senior Producer, Kimber delivered the event end to end, balancing creative ambition with the practical demands of a high-profile, high-security guest list.

The Emirates Aviation Experience is a 500 sqm two-floor interactive museum at Greenwich Peninsula in London, featuring four flight simulators, a large-scale A380 nose cone, a Rolls-Royce Trent 900 engine, and a 360-degree hologram.

As Project Lead, Kimber led a hand-built team of 40 to deliver the £7 million project from concept through to public opening.

Emirates' multi-year global sports sponsorship programme spanned some of the world's most prestigious tournaments. The schedule included ATP tennis activations at Wimbledon, Roland Garros, Barcelona Open, US Open, Indian Wells, and Rome, alongside PGA golf activations in Dubai, Kuala Lumpur, and Shanghai. On-the-ground delivery also covered the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.

As Senior Producer, Kimber developed each activation as a portable touring kit and produced between 10 and 18 events per calendar year.

On-the-ground production for Emirates' Cricket World Cup sponsorship activation across Australia and New Zealand, delivered as part of the same global sports touring programme as the ATP, PGA, and Commonwealth Games activations.

As Senior Producer, Kimber coordinated venue logistics, sponsor show elements, and live run-of-show alongside local crews and international stakeholders, keeping activations consistent with Emirates' global brand standards across multiple host cities.

project: NTT Data: The Open Championship Data Wall
body:
The NTT Data Wall transformed live R&A tournament data into a fully animated, data-rich visual experience on a large-scale LED screen at The Open Championship, supported by a digital second-screen experience for remote fans.

As Senior Producer, Kimber managed delivery of the on-course installation and the supporting digital experience end to end.

EA Sports' Battlefront II launch activation at Paris Games Week was a high-traffic public and press showcase staged in a major convention environment.

As Senior Producer, Kimber managed supplier coordination, rehearsals, and show-flow planning, and led on-site problem-solving across build, tech checks, and live periods to keep the immersive games-industry experience on schedule under peak audience load.

A touring laboratory designed and delivered for Johnson & Johnson Medical: a solar-powered trailer featuring a fully equipped laboratory, a conference room, and a VR suite, showcasing the latest robot-assisted knee surgery technology to healthcare professionals across Australia.

As Executive Producer, Kimber led the design, build, and national tour delivery of the mobile lab.

Dubai's Golden Jubilee celebration at Expo 2020 featured content production for a 25,380 sqm projection surface using 252 projectors across 84 video channels.

As Project Lead, Kimber produced nearly a petabyte of content for the domed plaza installation, coordinating creative, technical, and rendering teams to deliver on schedule.

A touring experiential activation promoting the Samsung Galaxy A5, visiting five cities along Australia's east coast. The footprint was fully mobile, packing into a single 40-foot semi-trailer.

As Senior Producer, Kimber delivered the tour end to end, including build, transport logistics, on-site activation, and crew management at each stop.

Parrtjima is Australia's only authentic Aboriginal light festival, set against the dramatic backdrop of the MacDonnell Ranges in Alice Springs.

As Creative Technologist, Kimber helped bring the artists' visions to life through structure and sculpture, working in a dynamic nighttime desert environment alongside cultural custodians and the creative team.

Destination NSW's The Long Road campaign with Emotive was delivered as a six-episode TV series, supported by online content and national television distribution. The work focused on encouraging local tourism and regional travel across New South Wales.

As Producer, Kimber aligned creative, production, and partner teams, set scheduling and budget guardrails, managed stakeholder communication, and oversaw delivery across pre-production, shoots, and post-production so the series stayed on schedule and on brief.

Rizlab, Experiments in Music, was a brand platform funding the creative visions of pioneering music artists, with a line-up that included Jamie xx, Quayola, Friendly Fires, and Ghostpoet.

As Producer, Kimber delivered the live programme. Direct event reach grew 600% year on year, reaching half a million people, and PR reach exceeded 16.5 million.

Aqua Rugby Australia is full-contact rugby union played on a 30x30m floating pitch in Darling Harbour, Sydney.

As Executive Producer, Kimber led event curation and delivery, developing revenue strategies, designing the on-water and shoreside infrastructure, and ensuring safety for both players and spectators.

The Gunpowder Plot is a permanent immersive theatre experience set beneath the Tower of London.

As Executive Producer, Kimber managed storyline design and development as well as the physical UX design of each room, collaborating closely with the director and the head of technical.
